minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the settlers solar hearing to Sept 10; a Gilchrist St ANR was withdrawn pending signed agreements.
minutes.summary: The board backed Jamie Toll for the MPO delegate seat, set a tentative fall schedule for marijuana regulation meetings, and allowed an ANR plan for Gilchrist Street to be withdrawn until purchase and sale agreements are signed. The main item was the remanded settlers solar public hearing on Northfield Road, with revised buffers, a larger tree fund and decommissioning bond. It was continued to September 10 for draft conditions and a fifth member.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the remanded solar public hearing on Northfield Road to September 10 so draft conditions can be prepared and a fifth member can sit.
Town counsel is to draft proposed conditions for the next meeting, and the applicant is to show the trail easement and fire department items.
The applicant agreed to raise the decommissioning bond and the tree fund, held in escrow for screening plantings directed by the board.
The board accepted withdrawal of a Gilchrist Street ANR plan without prejudice and waived the fee for resubmission once purchase and sale agreements are signed.
The board recommended Jamie Toll for the MPO sub-regional delegate seat and set a tentative fall schedule for marijuana regulation meetings.

why_it_matters: The solar project's screening, decommissioning bond and tree fund set what neighbors see and who bears the cost if the site is later abandoned, and those terms are still being settled.
The marijuana regulation meetings this fall will shape where retail and cultivation businesses can locate in town, and the public can attend them.
